adjudicated.jp: 「十代の先鋭的な部分ばかりにとらわれた思想だね」
adjudicated.en: Tomoki: "That's an idea that's all slave of a teenager's radicalist module."
comments: "It's all chuunibyou, dude". -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The source critiques a worldview fixated only on the cutting-edge or radical aspects of adolescence. 'All slave of a teenager's radicalist module' is ungrammatical and invents a mechanistic module.

adjudicated.jp: 「まだ熱血甲子園君だっていっぱいいるんだよ」
adjudicated.en: Tomoki: "There's still lots of Hot Blooded Koshien-kun out there, you know."
comments: "People still exist damn you". http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/High_school_baseball_in_Japan seems to be taken in contrast to the revolutionaristicoid pretentious pseudo-nihilism of above (and more). -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The baseball-archetype label should use standard Hepburn Kōshien. 'Koshien' leaves the long vowel unmarked, and singular 'kun' conflicts with the many people referenced.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'There are still plenty of hot-blooded Kōshien types out there.'

highlights.text: Tomoki: "There's still lots of Hot Blooded Koshien-kun out there, you know."

adjudicated.jp: 「あ、彼らはポストモダンとか言ってる連中のなかでは観察価値のある人間って見なされてないから」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Ah, but among those of us who use words such as 'postmodern', they would not be considered as humans with any observational worth."
comments: "I am so damn pretentious I'm acting as if certain people don't exist", with "oh wait there's no one anymore" as the implied subtext, but being actually a double troll. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The source refers to people who talk about postmodernism from the outside. 'Those of us' makes the speaker a member of that group, while 'humans with observational worth' is an unidiomatic recasting of people worth observing.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'Among the people who talk about postmodernism, they aren't considered worth observing.'

highlights.text: Taichi: "Ah, but among those of us who use words such as 'postmodern', they would not be considered as humans with any observational worth."

comments: HACK this doesn't fill the whole box to the right because the Amaterasu hacks still only allow a maximum of 59-60 characters per line, but reducing the text size a bit made this fit.

Surface: "I'm going to show how desperate I am by continuing to do what I was doing before despite circumstances changing significantly", deeper: "I know this nonexistent mankind is all an act and I'm just repeating things to pretend it isn't".
